subject: Trial kickoff: availability & security gating for GreenBridge pilot
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@greenbridge.io>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Trial kickoff: availability & security gating for GreenBridge pilot

Hi Ellen —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call last week. Per our notes, we'd like to lock in a 60-minute kickoff to align timeline, success criteria, and owners across engineering, procurement, and security so the trial can start by July 6. Proposed agenda (30/60 minutes):

- Introductions + goals (5m)
- Success criteria & acceptance tests (15m)
- Timeline / milestone map to production pilot start (10m)
- Roles & escalation paths (10m)
- Security & procurement gating / next artifacts (10m)

Success criteria suggestions (we can edit live):
- Basic integration: API connectivity and sample inference within 48 hours of account provisioning
- Latency target: 95th percentile under 350ms for 512-token requests in your test harness
- Cost telemetry: token-level cost reporting enabled and validated in Redwood Console
- Security gating: SOC2 evidence + network allowlist and KMS configuration validated prior to data ingestion

Suggested kickoff windows (ET / PT equivalent in parens):
- Tue, Jun 29 — 10:00–11:00 ET (07:00–08:00 PT)
- Wed, Jun 30 — 14:00–15:00 ET (11:00–12:00 PT)
- Thu, Jul 1 — 11:00–12:00 ET (08:00–09:00 PT)

Attachments: security_questionnaire_GB.pdf (security checklist), draft_sow_redwood_v1.pdf (SOW + timeline).

Can you confirm primary procurement and security contacts so we include them on the call? Once we have a slot we’ll send a calendar invite and a short runbook for the SE to run the initial smoke test.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Strategic AE | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0187
